body:
Question:
A closed cube with 0.20 m edges contains no charge. It sits in a uniform external electric field of 300 N/C directed perpendicular to two of its faces. What is the net electric flux through the entire surface of the cube?

A. 12 N·m²/C
B. 0 N·m²/C
C. 72 N·m²/C
D. 24 N·m²/C

Question:
A closed surface encloses a +4.0 nC charge and a −4.0 nC charge. A separate +6.0 nC charge sits outside the surface. What is the net electric flux through the surface?

A. 9.0 × 10² N·m²/C
B. 0 N·m²/C
C. 4.5 × 10² N·m²/C
D. 6.8 × 10² N·m²/C

Question:
A thin, uniformly charged spherical shell of radius 0.20 m carries a total charge of +12 nC. A concentric spherical Gaussian surface of radius 0.10 m lies entirely inside the shell. What is the net electric flux through the Gaussian surface?

A. 0 N·m²/C
B. 1.4 × 10³ N·m²/C
C. 3.4 × 10² N·m²/C
D. 1.7 × 10² N·m²/C

Question:
A 4.0 kg block slides down a frictionless incline that makes an angle of 30° with the horizontal. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the incline on the block?

A. 20 N
B. 35 N
C. 40 N
D. 46 N

Question:
A 2.5 kg crate slides down a frictionless ramp whose horizontal length is 4.0 m and whose height is 3.0 m. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the ramp on the crate?

A. 19 N
B. 25 N
C. 15 N
D. 20 N

Question:
A 2.0 kg block slides down a frictionless plane. The surface of the plane makes an angle of 25° with the vertical. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the plane on the block?

A. 8.5 N
B. 18 N
C. 47 N
D. 20 N

Question:
A 3.0 kg cart of constant mass moves along a straight track with velocity v(t) = (4.0 m/s²)t + 1.0 m/s, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the cart at t = 2.0 s?

A. 13.5 N
B. 27 N
C. 12 N
D. 4.0 N

Question:
A 1.5 kg block of constant mass moves along a line with velocity v(t) = (2.0 m/s⁴)t³ − (3.0 m/s²)t, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the block at t = 2.0 s?

A. 3.0 N
B. 15 N
C. 7.5 N
D. 31.5 N

Question:
A 2.0 kg object of constant mass moves along the x-axis with position x(t) = (0.50 m/s⁴)t⁴ − (2.0 m/s)t, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the object at t = 1.5 s?

A. 13.5 N
B. 9.5 N
C. 27 N
D. 9.0 N

Question:
A rigid sealed container holds an ideal gas at 27°C and a pressure of 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa. The gas is heated to 177°C. What is its final pressure?

A. 1.5 × 10⁵ Pa
B. 6.7 × 10⁴ Pa
C. 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa
D. 6.6 × 10⁵ Pa

Question:
A rigid vessel holds a fixed amount of ideal gas. Its pressure is 120 kPa at 27°C and 160 kPa at 127°C, and the graph of pressure versus Celsius temperature is a straight line. The line is extended down to zero pressure. At what Celsius temperature does it reach zero pressure?

A. −300°C
B. −73°C
C. 0°C
D. −273°C

Question:
A rigid sealed tank holds an ideal gas at 27°C. To what Celsius temperature must the gas be heated so that its pressure becomes three times its initial value?

A. 9°C
B. 900°C
C. 627°C
D. 81°C
